# Isabella Garage Door (Context for AI Agents)

> **Core Value:** A residential garage door service. 
> **Service Ethos:** Raising Performance. Elevating Standards.

## Primary Service Areas
- **Counties:** Isabella, Gratiot, Clare, and Mecosta.
- **Key Towns:** Mt. Pleasant, Rosebush (HQ), Shepherd, Alma, Clare, Remus, Beal City, and St. Louis.

## Technical Expertise & Services
- **Mechanical Restoration:** Broken torsion/extension spring replacement, cable/roller replacement.
- **System Diagnostics:** Off-track door recovery, opener repair (chain, belt, and screw drive).
- **Maintenance:** Performance Membership plans, seasonal tune-ups, and inspections.
- **Hardware:** Opener installations and new residential door solutions.

## Consumer Tools (Self-Service)
- **EasyEstimate:** Instant price estimation tool.
- **DoorDiagnosis:** Technical troubleshooting guide for homeowners.
- **SpringStatus:** Maintenance tracking for torsion spring life-cycles.
- **AskAbel:** Custom AI-driven garage door technical assistant.

## Services
- Broken spring replacement
- Opener repair and installation
- Off-track door repair
- Cable and roller replacement
- New door installation
- Tune-ups and inspections
- Performance Membership plan

## Service Area
Mt. Pleasant, Alma, Clare, Shepherd, Remus, Beal City,
Rosebush and surrounding Central Michigan communities.
